rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Minutes of the Senate Mesa meeting held at 12:00 on 1 October 1992 with the President of the Supreme Federal Court, Minister Sydney Sanches, to formalize the summons of the President of the Republic and give effect to his removal from the functions of President under Article 86 §2: the summons was approved and signed by the President of the Senate, Mauro Benevides, and by Sanches, who took over the presidency of the process.

locator.item: ATA - MESA, Ata da reunião realizada às 12:00 horas do dia 1º de outubro de 1992 (continues on printed page 790)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Mandado de Citação to President Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello, dated Senado Federal 1 October 1992 and signed by Sanches and Benevides, summons him to answer the accusation admitted by the Chamber and states that from receipt of the summons the process is instituted and he is suspended from the functions of President of the Republic under Article 86 §1(II) of the Constitution until the judgment is concluded or the period in §2 elapses.

locator.item: MANDADO DE CITAÇÃO (continues on printed page 788)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: Message SM nº 190/92, dated Senado Federal 1 October 1992 and signed by Sanches and Benevides, informs Vice-President Itamar A. C. Franco that the President has been summoned and in consequence is suspended from his functions until the judgment is concluded or the constitutional period elapses, and that the Vice-President is to assume the Presidency of the Republic immediately under Article 79.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In the contra-fé, signed 'F. Collor' at the Palácio do Planalto on 2 October 1992, Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello acknowledges receiving at 10:20 that day the summons signed by the President of the Supreme Federal Court and the Senate Mesa, presented by the First Secretary, Senator Dirceu Carneiro; under the summons' own terms the process is instituted and the President suspended from his functions from its receipt.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 only. Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Vice-presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded except the Vice-President's exercise of the office, recorded as rows only.
